notes.title: Patch 0.12.313 - Card system rework
notes.content: [p]Hey, it's been a while, but I have something special for you. [/p][p]I completely reworked card mechanics.  Now your cards were separated into 3 groups: hand, draw pile, and discard pile. Every in-game day, you get 5 cards from the draw pile to your hand. Every card you don't use on that day goes to the discard pile. When your draw pile is empty, cards from the  discard pile are reshuffled to the draw pile. Also, on reshufling, you will get cards from structures in your town. Yes, now there's no need to return to the town to get new units. Also, some cards have a  tag \[Persistent] that means that even if you use this card, the card goes to the discard pile. Because of that, some cards you can play many times in one game.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43040473/8fe7ed15670f322bbd8b811542b8bf85e90c5c6d.png"][/img][/p][p]I also added a new resource: Pearls. It's premium resource that can be used to more advanced cards. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43040473/da41c6c8fdb15511ba07cdc172b090a3c20ae5f7.png"][/img][/p][p]Also, a nice change is that you no longer need to return to town to upgrade your units.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43040473/5600b3e222aed74fb5e7db721f486b8335b5c0e8.png"][/img][/p][p]I also added 2 more demiurges to knuckefest from the last campaign: Barlius and Vulcanus[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43040473/8048e5f34897f67837e3bbfe0a0386c3d8638751.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Full changes:[/p][list][*][p]card system rework[/p][/*][*][p]2 new knuckefest demiurges[/p][/*][*][p]new card creation window[/p][/*][*][p]tutorial fixes[/p][/*][*][p]new resource: pearls[/p][/*][*][p]dwellings rework[/p][/*][*][p]new cards[/p][/*][*][p]rework units upgrade[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.12.304 - multiplayer mode, new main menu
notes.content:
Hey, this time I have something big for you: a completely new multiplayer mode. In this mode, you played against 7 other players. Every turn, you could buy some cards to make your hero stronger. Then you fight in auto battles. If you lose, you lose a life. If you lost all of this, you lost. The last one wins.

Also, I completely changed the main menu. Now it looks like this:

I hope you will like this.

notes.content:

notes.title: Patch 0.9.142 - Fleshwood Forest
notes.content:
Hey, today I have for you a new update with a new region: Fleshwood Forest. 

Fleshwood Forest is a dark and eerie location, where instead of towering trees, grotesque pieces of flesh jut out from the ground, twisted and contorted in unnatural shapes. A foul stench permeates the air, emanating from the decaying flesh that blankets the forest floor.

It's the second region that you could unlock by defeating the first boss.
